answer_2.quote: TER was used because of its popularity as an automatic translation quality metric, and because it counts edit operations and therefore reflects PE effort.

answer_4.quote: After each segment, participants had to press confirm... we also showed a pop-up asking "Was the word-level quality estimation helpful?" which the participant had to rate on a 9-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the helpfulness of the word-level QE on a 9-point Likert scale and indicated visualization preference.
